name: S4-jump
note: Plan S4: 40 x Next, then 20 x Prev, then Home (FirstImage). ShortcutMappings has no End/LastImage shortcut, so End is omitted. Random jumps are not modelled. Next/Prev use event-driven settle (each key waits for present + preload-idle, capped at settleMaxMs, then >=settleMinMs) instead of a fixed 1500ms wait; comparable with older interval-1500 runs only in semantics -- each key still starts from a settled state -- not in wall time.
